description: 모델 가격 정책 기반 팀/사용자/repository별 추정 비용 분석

targets.rawSql: select now() as time, sum(total_estimated_cost) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$);
select now() as time, sum(total_estimated_cost) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where usage_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date;

select now() as time, round(sum(total_estimated_cost)   * extract(days from (date_trunc('month', current_date + interval '1 month') - date_trunc('month', current_date)))   / nullif(extract(day from current_date), 0), 4) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where usage_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date;

select now() as time, sum(total_requests) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$);

select usage_date as time, team as metric, sum(total_estimated_cost) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date, team order by usage_date;

select usage_date as time, model as metric, sum(total_estimated_cost) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date, model order by usage_date;

panels.description: 최근 7일 x 24시간 estimated cost를 고정 threshold(0, $0.10, $0.50, $2.00, $5.00) 기준 0~5 단계로 표시

targets.rawSql: with filtered as (select (event_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as local_date, extract(hour from event_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::int as hour_of_day, total_estimated_cost from codex_usage_events_with_cost where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$)), anchor as (select coalesce(max(local_date), (current_timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date) as end_date from filtered), days as (select generate_series((select end_date - 6 from anchor), (select end_date from anchor), interval '1 day')::date as local_date), hours as (select generate_series(0, 23) as hour_of_day), cells as (select d.local_date, h.hour_of_day, coalesce(sum(f.total_estimated_cost), 0) as hourly_cost from days d cross join hours h left join filtered f on f.local_date = d.local_date and f.hour_of_day = h.hour_of_day group by 1, 2), scored as (select local_date, hour_of_day, case when hourly_cost >= 5 then 5 when hourly_cost >= 2 then 4 when hourly_cost >= 0.5 then 3 when hourly_cost >= 0.1 then 2 when hourly_cost > 0 then 1 else 0 end as activity_level from cells) select case extract(isodow from local_date) when 1 then '월' when 2 then '화' when 3 then '수' when 4 then '목' when 5 then '금' when 6 then '토' when 7 then '일' end as "요일", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 0) as "0", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 1) as "1", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 2) as "2", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 3) as "3", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 4) as "4", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 5) as "5", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 6) as "6", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 7) as "7", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 8) as "8", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 9) as "9", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 10) as "10", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 11) as "11", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 12) as "12", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 13) as "13", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 14) as "14", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 15) as "15", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 16) as "16", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 17) as "17", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 18) as "18", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 19) as "19", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 20) as "20", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 21) as "21", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 22) as "22", max(activity_level) filter (where hour_of_day = 23) as "23" from scored group by local_date order by local_date;

비용 구성 분석 (Input / Cached / Output / Reasoning)

targets.rawSql: select usage_date as time, 'input' as metric, sum(total_input_cost) as value from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date union all select usage_date, 'cached_input', sum(total_cached_input_cost) from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date union all select usage_date, 'output', sum(total_output_cost) from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date union all select usage_date, 'reasoning', sum(total_reasoning_cost) from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by usage_date order by 1;

panels.title: 팀 / 사용자 / 모델 / Repository 비용 집계

targets.rawSql: select team, sum(total_requests) as requests, sum(total_tokens) as tokens, round(sum(total_estimated_cost)::numeric,6) as estimated_cost_usd, round(sum(total_input_cost)::numeric,6) as input_cost, round(sum(total_cached_input_cost)::numeric,6) as cached_cost, round(sum(total_output_cost)::numeric,6) as output_cost, round(sum(total_reasoning_cost)::numeric,6) as reasoning_cost from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by team order by estimated_cost_usd desc;

select a.user_id, coalesce(m.display_name, a.user_id) as display_name, coalesce(a.team, m.team, '(unknown)') as team, sum(a.total_requests) as requests, sum(a.total_tokens) as tokens, round(sum(a.total_estimated_cost)::numeric,6) as estimated_cost_usd from codex_daily_cost_agg a left join codex_user_mapping m on lower(a.user_id) = lower(m.user_id) where $__timeFilter(a.usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or a.team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or a.model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or a.user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or a.repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by a.user_id, m.display_name, a.team, m.team order by estimated_cost_usd desc limit 30;

select model, sum(total_requests) as requests, sum(total_input_tokens) as input_tokens, sum(total_cached_input_tokens) as cached_tokens, sum(total_output_tokens) as output_tokens, sum(total_reasoning_tokens) as reasoning_tokens, round(sum(total_estimated_cost)::numeric,6) as estimated_cost_usd, min(price_policy_version) as price_version from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by model order by estimated_cost_usd desc;

select repository, team, sum(total_requests) as requests, sum(total_tokens) as tokens, round(sum(total_estimated_cost)::numeric,6) as estimated_cost_usd, min(usage_date) as first_seen, max(usage_date) as last_seen from codex_daily_cost_agg where $__timeFilter(usage_date) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) group by repository, team order by estimated_cost_usd desc;
select team, monthly_budget as max, current_month_cost as value from codex_team_budget_usage order by budget_usage_pct desc nulls last;

select team, monthly_budget as budget_usd, round(current_month_cost::numeric,4) as used_usd, round(remaining_budget::numeric,4) as remaining_usd, budget_usage_pct as usage_pct, current_month_requests as requests, round(forecast_month_end_cost::numeric,4) as forecast_month_end_usd from codex_team_budget_usage order by budget_usage_pct desc nulls last;

select event_time, user_id, team, model, repository, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens, round(total_estimated_cost::numeric,8) as estimated_cost_usd, price_policy_version, cost_accuracy from codex_usage_events_with_cost where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;
